انصعت (form VII)
# اِنْصَعْتُ (inṣaʕtu) /in.sˤaʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْصَاعَ (inṣāʕa)
# اِنْصَعْتَ (inṣaʕta) /in.sˤaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْصَاعَ (inṣāʕa)
# اِنْصَعْتِ (inṣaʕti) /in.sˤaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْصَاعَ (inṣāʕa)
